    RemoteViewer
    The Remote Viewer application (ported from the standalone jrdesktop / Remote Viewer RMI remote-desktop tool): the original RemoteViewerPanel Swing UI (server start/stop, status, viewer connect, file transfer, about, exit - unchanged from the upstream MainFrame) presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow, exactly like every other hosted lg3d application (Password Manager, Docker Manager, Paint, ...).
    RemoteViewerPanel
    The original jrdesktop/Remote Viewer main GUI (server controls, status, viewer connect, about, exit), unchanged in content and layout from the standalone application.
    SysTray
     
    ViewerHost
    Hosts the Remote Viewer's live-viewing panel (Recorder.viewerPanel) inside whichever desktop is running, so the viewer window belongs to the desktop and is captured by the desktop screenshot instead of escaping it as a stray top-level OS window beside the desktop.
